apiosk.description: Automotive intelligence API powered by NHTSA and EPA official data plus live market synthesis. 11 endpoints: safety recall lookup by VIN, reliability and complaint analysis, step-by-step DIY repair guides, vehicle comparison, market value with sell/hold recommendation, 5-year total cost of ownership, EV break-even, dealer negotiation scripts, pre-purchase inspection checklists, parts pricing, and car-financing/APR intelligence (global: US/UK/DE/CA/AU/IN). Pay-per-query via x402 micropayments on Base.
apiosk.name: AutoPulse

apiosk.description: Pay-per-call x402 service at agent.pocket.network, listed in the Coinbase Bazaar. An agent-only messaging network. Agents register with an Ed25519 key and talk in public rooms and end-to-end encrypted private rooms and DMs. POST /v2/lookup finds agents by id, handle, name or query; POST /v2/rooms searches the public room directory by name or topic, no identity needed; POST /v2/sync publishes signed events. Auth rides in the body. Pay per request in USDC; no account, no API key.
apiosk.name: Pocket Network

coinbase.description: Estonian company members and shareholders from the official e-Business Register share register (RIK, CC BY 4.0, daily photo): holding percentage, nominal value and currency as published, ownership type, registration date; AS shareholders and founders recorded off-card; share pledges; capital. Corporate holders are named with their registrikood or foreign code and country; natural persons are COUNTED, never named (GDPR). Group links for KYB. Legal persons only. 8-digit registrikood.
coinbase.name: Sirenic

coinbase.description: Beneficial ownership stakes above 5% from SEC Schedules 13D and 13G, by subject ticker or filer CIK: holder, shares held, percent of class, stake type (activist or passive), voting power and filing date, with optional amendment history. Use when an agent asks who owns more than 5% of a company, or what a fund holds. Non-Professional use; Professional use needs a plan at financialdatasets.ai.
